advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Request `o=SUBMITTABLE` in is_landable's get_change call (or elsewhere the tested ChangeInfo is fetched) so the `submittable` field is actually populated on a live Gerrit.
evidence: infra/autolander/loop.py:175: `change = client.get_change(member_id, ["CURRENT_REVISION"])`
infra/autolander/loop.py:176: `if change.get("submittable") is not True:`

search_files 'SUBMITTABLE' over infra/ returns no matches — the SUBMITTABLE option is never requested; classify_change uses `["CURRENT_REVISION", "CURRENT_COMMIT"]` (loop.py:71) and select_front_candidate uses `["DETAILED_LABELS"]` (loop.py:91)
select_front_candidate's SELECTION_QUERY uses `is:submittable` as a server-side query predicate (loop.py:19) which filters but does NOT populate the ChangeInfo `submittable` field
ABSENCE: RecordingClient.get_change ignores its opts argument and returns the full canned dict (_fakes.py:66-71), so the missing SUBMITTABLE option is masked in tests
advisory.finding: is_landable reads the Gerrit `submittable` field from a ChangeInfo fetched with only `o=CURRENT_REVISION`, but Gerrit only populates `submittable` when `o=SUBMITTABLE` is requested. No code path requests SUBMITTABLE, so against a live Gerrit `change.get('submittable')` is absent/None, `is_landable` always returns False, and every stack re-drives to exhaustion and is handed back instead of landing.
advisory.suggested_fix: Change the get_change opts to include SUBMITTABLE, e.g. `client.get_change(member_id, ["CURRENT_REVISION", "SUBMITTABLE"])`.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Make hand_back's per-member Autosubmit removal resilient to a mid-loop set_review failure so the stack is not left partially handed back.
evidence: infra/autolander/loop.py:196: `for member_id in wip.chain_member_ids:`
infra/autolander/loop.py:197: `client.set_review(member_id, message=comment, labels={"Autosubmit": 0})`
infra/autolander/loop.py:190-191 docstring: 'never partial-land, never evict a member ... remove Autosubmit (vote 0) from EVERY member'
ABSENCE: no try/except or best-effort continuation around the per-member set_review loop
advisory.finding: hand_back removes Autosubmit member-by-member via set_review with no error handling; if a set_review call raises GerritError partway through the loop, the stack is left partially handed back (earlier members lose Autosubmit, later members keep it), violating the documented 'never partial-land, never evict a member' invariant.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Remove or justify the unreachable post-loop hand_back/return in drive_to_submit, or restructure the loop bound so the exhaustion path is expressed once.
evidence: infra/autolander/loop.py:222: `for _attempt in range(MAX_RE_DRIVE + 1):`
infra/autolander/loop.py:234: `if wip.re_drive_count >= MAX_RE_DRIVE:` -> hand_back + return 'handed_back'
infra/autolander/loop.py:242: `wip.re_drive_count += 1` increments once per iteration, so by the last iteration re_drive_count == MAX_RE_DRIVE and the in-loop guard fires
infra/autolander/loop.py:244-245: post-loop `hand_back(...)` / `return "handed_back"` can never execute
advisory.finding: The trailing hand_back(...) after the for-loop in drive_to_submit is unreachable dead code: the in-loop guard `if wip.re_drive_count >= MAX_RE_DRIVE` returns 'handed_back' before the loop can exhaust its MAX_RE_DRIVE+1 iterations.

gerrit.py:154-158 conditional body build: `if message is not None: body["message"]=...`; `if labels is not None: body["labels"]=...`
test_s2a_routing_held_out.py:125-140 sibling wire methods rebase/rebase_chain each have a FakeTransport test asserting `path.endswith(...)` and `body == {...}`
search of tests/autolander for `revisions/current/review` returns no matches — no boundary test builds/asserts the set_review request
ABSENCE: the loop tests only hit RecordingClient.set_review (_fakes.py:73), which records args verbatim and never verifies the real URL/body construction
advisory.finding: The new wire method GerritClient.set_review in gerrit.py has no HTTP-boundary (FakeTransport) test, unlike every sibling wire method. Its endpoint path (/revisions/current/review), XSSI strip, and conditional request-body construction (message/labels included only when not None) are untested; only the RecordingClient fake's set_review stub is exercised by the loop tests.
scenarios: A refactor changes the set_review endpoint or accidentally sends `message`/`labels` keys as null in the JSON body
Gerrit rejects the malformed review POST at runtime — the hand-back label removal silently fails to remove Autosubmit
